newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss tom/next money up before month-end.
newsitem.headline: Swiss tom/next money up before month-end.

text.p: 0755 GMT - Swiss tomorrow/next money rates were quoted higher in early trade on Tuesday, with the slight tightness attributed to technical demand before the end of the month.
One bank quoted tomorrow/next money at 1-7/8 to 2.00 percent, compared with levels of roughly 1-3/8 to 1-1/2 seen in recent sessions.

The Swiss National Bank was seen adding liquidity at 1-5/8 percent for 10 days from Tuesday. The rate was in line with rates set on similar operations sessions earlier in April. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
